scheme_name: Free Coaching for Students with Disabilities
other_conditions: Student must have at least 40% disability

Student must be preparing for competitive examinations conducted by UPSC, SSC, Railway Recruitment Boards (Group A and B), State Public Service Commissions (Group A and B), or other competitive exams for admission in higher educational institutions and jobs
Student family income must not exceed ₹600,000 per annum
Student can avail the benefits only once
Student should not be receiving any other similar scheme benefits from the Central Government
Voluntary organization must be registered under the Societies Registration Act, 1860, or the relevant State/UT Act
Voluntary organization must have been in existence for at least three years
Voluntary organization must have the necessary infrastructure and experience to provide coaching to students with disabilities
benefits_summary: Provides free coaching and financial assistance (stipend and study material) to students with disabilities for competitive examinations.
application_link: Visit the website of the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD). Go to the "Schemes" section and click on "Free Coaching for Students with Disabilities".
